scope: Two cross-split suspected pairs verified using mono waveforms at 24kHz. This is overlap evidence, not global song identity or complete song-level isolation.
method: FFT cross-correlation; search within +/-40ms of the coarse candidate lag; maximize absolute correlation; fit one signed gain; gain-normalized residual RMS divided by target RMS.
conclusion: The second pair has extremely similar audio across train and validation but different dance-genre labels. Existing retrieval metrics must not be represented as strictly song-isolated generalization. This does not establish the root cause of weak music-conditioned generation.
